Define whether waking interrupts, whether the recipient can answer, and what the caster knows about success without exposing protected sleep/location information. Nightmare needs a finite mechanical consequence,save,timing and recovery rule if NEW; no unprinted HP damage, exhaustion, lost rest or compulsive command is assumed. Compare reviewed Sleep and information/privacy boundaries. Treat dreams as the target's experience for this mechanical question; no dream plane,soul travel,theology or cosmology review occurs before the verified push. Recasts, suppression and successive rests cannot create unbounded queued messages or penalties.

completePreparedComparisonOccurrences.name: Charm Person

operational.targets: One living person you can perceive within range
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
operational.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On failure, it gains the CoreV2 Charmed condition toward you and regards you as friendly for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, and the first time each round you or your allies damage it, it repeats the Wisdom save; success ends the spell. On the initial save success, no effect.
operational.effect: Charm one person so it temporarily regards you as friendly. Charmed does not grant command authority, compel beliefs, reveal secrets, or force the target to obey requests.
operational.limitations: A player-controlled target retains full agency over choices and beliefs. The spell cannot force self-harm, confession, permanent allegiance, transfer of possessions, or actions beyond the CoreV2 Charmed restrictions. A creature that cannot be Charmed is unaffected. Only the first damage event each round grants the additional repeat save. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and Wisdom save are retained; F is represented as an existing class casting focus. Core lists Instantaneous duration, which conflicts with 'regards caster as friendly' and 'save ends early.' Concentration up to 1 minute and repeat-save cadence are NEW provisional operational decisions. Two source school placements are preserved externally; this record does not choose class access.

completePreparedComparisonOccurrences.name: Command

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within30feet and line of effect; speak one word in a language you know. Actual hearing/understanding and hidden impossibility/prohibited conduct are resolved after payment, not through a free targeting oracle.
operational.duration: One commanded regular turn, no concentration; ends at the target’s first future regular-turn END, excluding the current turn if underway. Extra turns do not execute the order. Outside initiative, resolve one ordinary behavior opportunity within6elapsed seconds; establish initiative if combat timing matters.
operational.resolution: If it cannot hear/understand the word, no command applies. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new command. Failure: it must perform a legal bounded interpretation on its next regular turn, using only its actual existing permissions. An impossible or prohibited command creates no behavior; no replacement word is chosen. Reserve the shared hard-control allowance when establishing any actual whole-Action/turn component. If blocked, only independently satisfiable non-hard movement/interaction portions may apply; do not invent another command.
operational.effect: After ordinary start-phase events, obey before contradictory voluntary choices. Approach: spend ordinary available movement toward you by a safe legal route, stopping on reaching an adjacent legal space or exhausting safe meaningful progress. Flee: spend ordinary available movement away by a safe legal route. Neither forces Dash or grants movement. Drop: ordinarily release one releasable held object chosen by the target/controller, using its actual ordinary release permission; ownership never transfers and normal later recovery remains possible. Halt: refrain from voluntary movement for that turn, without imposing Speed0 or preventing actual involuntary transport. Grovel: become/remain Prone for that turn if capable, without automatically losing Actions or legal crawling. Other one-word commands may require at most one coherent ordinary action/movement/interaction within this same turn and the limitations below; the word never grants an otherwise unavailable action or named condition. The target/controller chooses lawful details, safe route and object where the word leaves choices.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: No compelled attack/knowingly harmful act, direct self-harm, known serious hazard, protected/private secret disclosure, permanent surrender/ownership transfer, knowing binding-oath/duty violation, spell or optional limited-resource expenditure. If circumstances make the commanded behavior prohibited or impossible before execution, that portion fails rather than rewriting the word or extending the deadline. One pending Command application per target across casters; a later legally established failed-save application replaces it. No restoration of an older replaced command or spent hard-control allowance. A saved-against/wholly invalid new command creates no replacement. Simultaneous unresolved decisions use ordinary initiative order, else a fixed neutral order, never a caster’s after-the-fact preference. Unaffected Actions/BA/Reactions and movement remain; one-time Drop/Approach/Flee instructions finish once satisfied, while Halt/Grovel persist for the affected turn. Compelled movement uses the target’s movement and can provoke normal opportunity attacks. Hard whole-Action/turn components use the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independent printed components retain their own defense checks. A successfully established hard component claims the allowance once, not again each turn; ending, dispelling, replacing or suppressing it does not refund the encounter history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, actual one-word compulsion for1round. NEW: WIS/hearing/language and bounded safe-command procedure. Exact completions retain other bounded words, define ordinary action costs, nonbanking competition and one-time versus turn-long instructions; they do not turn compulsion into voluntary advice.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending

operational.duration: Concentration, until the start of your next regular turn

operational.effect: Create a static visual illusion that fits inside a 5-foot cube. It can depict a creature, object, surface feature, or visible phenomenon but produces no sound, smell, heat, force, or physical substance.
operational.limitations: The illusion cannot provide actual cover, support weight, block movement, create a usable object, cause damage, emit real light, conceal by physically obstructing line of effect, or trigger mechanisms. Creatures may still fail to realize it is false until they successfully Investigate. Cantrip repeats use Refrain. Physical passage through the image reveals its lack of substance to the interacting creature; no check is required to recognize that direct evidence. A known illusion grants no mechanical cover or blocked line of sight.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 5-foot range, V/S components, and concentration concept are retained, but Core says up to 1 minute while the source summary explicitly says the image lasts 1 round. This pilot follows the source's 1-round duration, expressed as concentration until the start of your next regular turn. Investigation vs Spell DC and nonphysical limitations are NEW provisional illusion rules.

completePreparedComparisonOccurrences.name: Mirror Image

operational.targets: Self; creates 3 illusory duplicates occupying your space and moving with you
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute or until all 3 duplicates are destroyed
operational.resolution: When an attack roll directly targets you, randomly select among you and all remaining duplicates with equal probability before the attack roll. If you are selected, resolve the attack against you normally. If a duplicate is selected, resolve the attack roll against your current AC; on a hit that duplicate is destroyed, and on a miss it remains. Area effects ignore the duplicates.
operational.effect: Create three illusory duplicates of yourself. Direct attack rolls may strike a duplicate instead of you until the duplicates are destroyed or concentration ends.
operational.limitations: Duplicates have no Actions, HP, independent positions, attacks, bodies, cover, collision, resource triggers, or ability to intercept saving-throw effects. They cannot be deliberately targeted by you or allies to generate procs. A creature that does not rely on sight or explicitly ignores visual illusions targets you normally. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
operational.designNotes: The two Core V2 entries conflict: one gives 30-foot range and concentration up to 1 minute, while the other gives Self and Instantaneous. Because the source consistently says duplicates of yourself, this pilot uses self range and retains the coherent 1-minute concentration duration. V/S/M/F is represented as a small reflective token or existing class casting focus. Equal random selection and duplicate-hit procedure are NEW provisional mechanics.

completePreparedComparisonOccurrences.name: Sleep

operational.targets: Declare an ordered list of distinct creatures you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect before hidden HP or defense resolution. A creature appears at most once in this cast’s list.
operational.duration: Independent Sleep-caused Unconscious on each affected creature, up to1minute, no concentration. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; an already-passed start never counts. Outside initiative, expires after 60 elapsed seconds. Retain the original virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and planar travel; moving between timing modes does not reset it.
operational.resolution: No saving throw. After casting commits and survives interruption, start one fixed budget of24. In declared order, each creature costs max(1, its current ordinary HP) at this resolution; temporary HP are ignored. If that cost exceeds the remaining budget, stop without attempting that creature or later entries. Otherwise deduct that cost before testing defenses/guard and attempt the Unconscious application. An attempted immune, protected or hard-guard-blocked creature still spends its HP cost. Budget/allocation/hidden defenses receive no special diagnostic disclosure; ordinary visible results remain observable.
operational.effect: A successful application imposes the actual Unconscious condition, including its inherited Incapacitated, awareness, movement, speech, held-item, Prone, save and attack consequences subject to actual component immunities. Each target uses its own shared source-character/target hard-control history. A0HP creature costs1 and retains its separate0HP state and Unconscious source. End a Sleep application when its target receives a positive damage packet after defenses and before temporary HP, when another creature within physical reach spends an Action rousing it, on its deadline, or through an applicable removal rule. Physical rousing by that Action ends all applications of this ordinary Sleep spell on that creature, but does not cure unrelated Unconscious causes. All Sleep applications independently see a qualifying damage event. The waking damage attack resolves using the conditions present for its roll/hit, then the damage event ends Sleep; no retroactive critical/hit reversal.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: A fully prevented zero packet does not wake by damage; positive packet can wake even if an HP floor prevents actual numeric HP loss. No self-awakening while Unconscious, automatic stabilization, healing, death-save reset or removal of other causes. No rolled HP budget, creature-type sleep immunity or concentration is imported. Recasts pay again and cannot refresh the shared guard; an unsuccessful new application leaves old valid sources intact. Suppression clocks continue and never replay the original drop/Prone event when suppression ends. Hard whole-Action/turn components use the existing combined source-character/target/encounter allowance across class features, spells and companions. A blocked hard component gains no invented fallback; independent printed components retain their own defense checks. A successfully established hard component claims the allowance once, not again each turn; ending, dispelling, replacing or suppressing it does not refund the encounter history. Actual boss/control immunities remain effective. Actual class access/repertoire, costs, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S requires the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary save rules. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity does not block effects that never impose Charmed. Actual broader defenses retain their written scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast or free identification of hidden eligibility.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,F, fixed24HP and explicitly no save. NEW: ordered current-HP/minimum1 budgeting, finite minute, waking and helper Action. Exact completion: helper rousing ends this named spell’s Sleep applications, not every cause of Unconscious; damage timing preserves an already determined hit/critical.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational PLAYTEST manuscript; runtime, human balance and broader Enchantment/social-control integration pending

completeInCohortCounterpartProposals.procedure: Action; one perceived designated hostile creature within60feet and line of effect; V/S/F; concentration up to60seconds. NEW this is a target-local mental audiovisual illusion, not a public party of creatures. The target makes WIS; success establishes nothing. Failure creates four chosen apparent allies of the caster, each fitting a10-foot cube, at distinct apparent positions within a fixed20-foot-radius sphere centered on the target's initial position. Only that recipient perceives their appearances and ordinary speech/noise; the caster designs them without gaining the recipient's thoughts or senses. Actual broader mental/illusion defenses apply; no Charmed or creature-type condition gate is added. Images have no bodies, occupied squares, attacks, HP, cover, touch, carrying or mechanical flanking. NEW finite misdirection: while the recipient can see at least one still-believed image within20feet of itself, its attack rolls have disadvantage from distraction. This is an explicit spell modifier, not automatic redirection, a forced victim choice or loss of its Action. It still chooses genuine actions and perceived targets; merely being within an image's apparent reach creates no OA. Images initially make only simple plausible idle movements/brief phrases chosen at casting. During the caster's own regular turn, an Action can move any/all images up to30apparent feet each within the original sphere and give each one brief phrase from the caster's actual knowledge; no later control without that cost, no actual movement mode or semantic command power. A target without the relevant sight cannot suffer the visual distraction; apparent sounds are capped at ordinary speech and confer no unknown language. An Action INT/Investigation vs DC recognizes the whole party and ends this target's application on success. Direct physical contradiction, such as actual passage through/touch of an image, also reveals the common illusion and ends it without a roll; a remote miss or an area effect not physically testing it is not automatically proof. Actual senses expressly bypassing visual/mental illusions prevent the relevant false perception. Leaving the original sphere or losing sight removes current distraction but does not reset expiry or move the images. One active Group Illusion application per recipient across casters; only a successfully established replacement ends the prior application. Recognition/death/removal/concentration loss/expiry ends it. No hard-control allowance is claimed for this soft distraction.
completeInCohortCounterpartProposals.newChoices: NEW one-target mental illusion, four finite images, WIS admission, actual attack-disadvantage meaning of misdirection, paid image control, whole-party Investigation/physical recognition and one-family replacement.
workedCases: EN5-03-A: After a failed WIS save, the target sees four apparent hostile-to-it allies in the original sphere. It attacks a real opponent with disadvantage while seeing a nearby image; neither the image nor caster receives a free attack or physical flanking benefit. The target can instead spend its Action investigating.

EN5-03-B: The target walks through an image along a legal route and recognizes the entire false party. The application ends, but concentration costs are not refunded. An observer other than the affected creature never saw a physical party and cannot use its supposed bodies as cover or cargo helpers.
completeInCohortCounterpartProposals.originalQuestion: Preserve creation of an illusionary PARTY OF ALLIES that misdirects one target enemy, Enchantment school, Core Action/60ft/concentration up to one minute. Define a finite image count,size,placement,motion,senses, caster control cost and who perceives the images. Resolve whether this is an external illusion or one target's mental effect, with actual initial/repeat disbelief or save procedures and a finite meaning for misdirected. Distinguish mistaken information/target selection from forced actions and hard control; decide interaction with true sight, touch, attacks, area damage and existing Mirror Image/Silent Image source boundaries. No actual creatures, extra attacks, occupied spaces, flanking, cover, carrying, shared senses or freely chosen stolen actions arise from the word allies. State effect-ending and suppression without delayed commands.

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Once per turn, spend 1 Blood Gauge while casting to prevent 1 Dissonance; the Agent routes Weave strain through blood rather than gaining free casts.
completeCurrentEnvelope.rpAuthority: Explicit fallback: Cleric CoreV2 curve ×0.5, halves upward
engine: Blood Gauge (BG) starts and ends each encounter at 0, capacity 3; Spill Control raises capacity 6 while known. Once on your own regular turn, a weapon attack that damages a hostile living creature grants 1 BG. Hemorrhage Slash uses this same trigger, not an additional one. Explicit critical/kill/refund features can add more, but total BG gained is capped 2 per round. Self-inflicted damage, allies, summons, helpless captives and repeated damage to a corpse never generate BG. Blood is an encounter resource, not a currency carried into rest.

Dexterity governs weapon attacks; Intelligence governs hemomancy save DC and M. S scales from Crimson Agent class level. A weapon technique includes only its printed attacks, with normal weapon die plus Dexterity (or Strength when that weapon requires it). No free attack is implied by attack-speed wording. Class BG and RP are separate. Once per turn when casting an ordinary spell, optionally spend 1 BG to prevent 1 of that cast's Dissonance gain, minimum 0; never reduce RP this way.

Your Bleed is a physical ongoing effect on a living, non-bloodless creature: 1d4 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns, then ends. It is not a new attack and generates no BG or procs. Refresh duration instead of stacking; Blood Echo expressly allows two independent instances, maximum. An Action by the victim or an adjacent creature using a healer's kit ends all your Bleeds on that victim. Apply physical resistance/immunity normally. Track remaining ticks and creator per instance. Allied healing versions from Bloodweaver cost RP and never count as hostile Bleeds for detonation, spreading or generation.

One Blood Mark at a time on a living target with your Bleed, except Phantom Strike, which explicitly may apply the mark without Bleed. It does not add a free Bleed. Marks last 5 of your regular turns, expire on encounter end or if the target dies, and never create damage by themselves. Rupture requires the target still within 60 ft and line of effect; it spends the mark. A mark does not defeat cover, planar boundaries or bloodlessness. Bloodtrail has its own tracking limits.

Veinweaves are self buffs unless their card expressly allows an ally. They require concentration and one may be active. Crimson Harmony is an explicit exception permitting two Veinweaves as one linked concentration burden; a failed concentration check ends both. A non-Veinweave concentration effect replaces the whole group. BG is spent on activation; no upkeep unless printed. Damage-sharing is redirection before mitigation, not extra damage: apply each recipient's own defenses once and never redirect the redirected portion again.

The healing, execution and denial text below deliberately bounds the source's vague percentage/instant-kill claims. HP sacrificed is direct loss, bypasses temporary HP and defenses, cannot be redirected, and cannot reduce the donor below 1. Only a willing ally can donate. HP sacrifice is never damage for class triggers. No class feature here restores the dead or removes Wounds.

At level 1 learn the core Blood Gauge/Bleed rules automatically. Blood Mark and Veinweaver's Core remain selections; Quickblood can be selected and used without a second unlock tax. Veinweaver's Core improves that foundation as printed. Standard scheduled acquisition applies. Bloodbound Edge is automatic 9. At 10 choose Bloodweaver, Shadow Operative or Thirstborn; its Final Cut is automatic 20. Duplicate Hemostasis names are separate Arch and Bloodweaver IDs.

Capacity clarification: Blood Gauge automatically reaches capacity 6 at class 9. Spill Control allows reaching 6 early but never raises the cap above 6. This new explicit gate ensures a later 5-BG Final Cut can be used without an optional capacity selection. Gain cap 2/round and encounter reset 0 still apply.
workedExample: Bard-style example becomes Agent 5: DEX 16, INT 14, S 2, M 2, BG 0/cap 3, full class RP. Select Hemorrhage Slash, Quickblood, Blood Mark, Shroud at 1; Blood Tithe and Vital Targeting at 2; Rupture and Spill Control at 3. Capacity is now 6.
Turn 1: Hemorrhage Slash hits for ordinary weapon damage+2d6, applies Bleed, and gains 1 BG (not 2). Bonus Action Blood Mark pays 1 BG: balance 0. Target takes its first 1d4 Bleed on its next turn.
Turn 2: ordinary weapon attack hits and gains 1 BG. Keep the mark and save resources; Bleed ticks independently and grants no BG.
Turn 3: a second weapon hit gains 1 BG: balance 2. Bonus Action Quickblood spends 1 BG: balance 1. It gives movement, not another attack.

Turn 4: Rupture is an Action, pays 1 BG: balance 0 and consumes the mark. Target fails CON: takes(S+1)d8=3d8. Rupture is not a weapon hit, so it generates no replacement BG. Any remaining Bleed continues.
After the encounter BG becomes 0. Blood Tithe's used short-rest charge and spent RP do not refresh without an actual rest.
balanceQuestions: Does early setup take too many turns for one mark?
Can Bloodweaver protect without sacrifice loops or infinite healing?
Are denial and execution limits sufficient against bosses and multiclass dips?
