# Fishing — operational playtest candidate

**REVIEWED — authored operational PLAYTEST.** Public: 28 formulas, nine models and thirteen operative affinities.

The source conference and completed FI-E01–11 exact-review corrections authorize this operational PLAYTEST candidate alongside the preserved recipe fields. Use the [crafting and harvesting framework](CRAFTING_HARVEST_PLAYTEST.md), [equipment procedures](EQUIPMENT_ITEM_PROCEDURES.md), [body and carrying rules](BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md) and [Core resolution](CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md) in their reviewed scopes. Actual site availability, source access and physical arrangements are required; a named ingredient or catalog entry does not supply them.

## Start one attempt

Ordinary provision fishing uses one lead, one real site opportunity and one complete Rod, Net or Trap capture assembly. The prey must actually be present, receptive to the method, physically compatible and have an ordinary provision-catching profile. This does not defeat an actively resisting encounter creature, a character or a companion. Unsupported dangerous or larger catches require their own procedure.

Before setup, record the site and shared stock, opportunity, real candidate creatures, hazards, catch profile, DC, receiving arrangement, apparatus and tools, and the known recovery-category order. Reserve the actual opportunity and items. A lead may have only one unresolved Fishing deployment. Cancellation before commitment releases reservations but never time already spent. At first deployment/exposure, spend the opportunity, expose any bait, choose one attraction source and allocate at most one response atomically. After commitment, interruption, failure or abandonment refunds neither opportunity nor bait.

An ordinary attempt is five active minutes of assembly/deployment, fifty minutes of fishing, a check at minute 55, then five active retrieval minutes. No work block compresses into one combat Action: every six seconds credited as active work commits that worker's Action and required hands. Conditions, threats and incompatible work can prevent progress. Active fishing, setup and retrieval share the crafting framework's two-active-work-Watch ceiling; they cannot also be travel, guard duty, rest or crafting.

Record setup start separately from first deployment/exposure during those five minutes. Dry setup at minute 0, first exposure at minute 5, the check at minute 55 and ordinary secure retrieval at minute 60 is valid; that dose expires at minute 65. Earlier actual exposure starts only the receipt clock earlier. It never restarts the attempt clock. Keep the governing pre-setup inventory reservation receipt and the distinct setup/fishing work records. A Trap needs its five actual setup minutes first and then fifty minutes continuously deployed; doing the only setup work at minutes 50–55 cannot qualify its minute-55 check.

Pre-exposure cancellation records actual worked time and any materials already spent or destroyed, releases only still-unspent reservations, and creates no replacement inventory. Rig mounting is a separate five minutes before main setup and remains worked time if the later setup is cancelled. After commitment, the opportunity and exposed bait remain spent. Order simultaneous expiry, capture and closure by the registered time/phase/sequence checkpoints; matching displayed timestamps do not extend an expired receipt.

Use **d 20 + WIS + one applicable proficiency contribution + independently legal bonuses**. Expertise replaces PB. The declared ordinary DC is 12 for accessible conditions,15 for materially difficult current/cover/access, or 18 for severe but feasible conditions. A separately reviewed catch profile may supply its own DC. Recipe DC, tier, value and crafting time do not set catch parameters; impossible access has no routine check.

Keep the declared catch profile and DC with the resolved Core check and the lead's actual Fishing credential. Each canonical roll belongs to only one attempt, including after closure. An attack, another ability or proficiency, a harvesting task, an automatic result or a non-roll cannot become a catch by assigning it Success or zero equipment bonus. The resolved proficiency term must be zero when untrained, PB when trained, or the replacing expertise contribution; record the untrained disadvantage source in Core. Trap configuration permits only its recorded WIS and that single proficiency term. Other independently lawful bonuses to an attended catch require their own evidence for that check.

Use Core's four task degrees and natural-result shifts, then collapse Critical Success/Success to one interception and Failure/Critical Failure to no catch. There is no critical extra specimen, recovery unit or time discount. Critical Failure causes only the hazard assigned to that opportunity beforehand; absent one, invent no injury, Pressure, contamination or gear damage. Untrained ordinary fishing is WIS without tool PB and with disadvantage. Catching has no recipe-level/formula gate or crafting XP. Automatic results receive no check bonus and create no replacement roll; this candidate supplies no automatic catch.

One trained Rod/Net assistant grants+1 only after completing the five setup and fifty fishing minutes alongside the lead before the check. Assistance never supplies the lead's missing hands. Later retrieval help costs real time and cannot qualify an earlier roll. Trap setting has no generic assistant bonus.

## Complete bodies and physical methods

| Complete body | gp | lb | HP / structural AC | Methods |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Eyed 2-inch steel hook, 0.5-inch gape | 0.1 | 0.02 | 5 / 19 | Rod |
| Continuous 50-foot waxed-fiber line with end fittings | 0.2 | 0.25 | 5 / 11 | Rod |
| 3-inch wooden lure and attachment eye; no hook | 0.2 | 0.05 | 5 / 15 | Rod, Net, Trap |
| 6-foot wooden rod with grip and guides; no line or hook | 0.5 | 2 | 5 / 15 | Rod |
| 6 x 4 x 2-inch control board, winder, float, sinker and clips; no rod, line or hook | 1 | 1 | 5 / 15 | Rod |
| Dip-net: 6-foot handle, 2-foot hoop, 2-foot-deep bag, 0.5-inch mesh and bait clip | 2 | 3 | 5 / 11 | Net |
| 24 x 12 x 12-inch basket with funnel, service door, bait holder and 20-foot recovery cord | 4 | 4 | 5 / 15 | Trap |
| 6 x 4 x 4-inch perforated steel chum dispenser with lid, mount and 10-foot tether | 2 | 1 | 5 / 19 | Rod, Net, Trap |
| Single 0.10-pound carrier dose and 0.01-pound wrapper; 2 x 1 x 1-inch packet | 0.02 | 0.11 | 1 / 11 | Rod, Net, Trap |

All models have fixed dimensions and Standard equipment grade; no automatic Large scaling. Each is a magical nonartifact after lawful creation, without attunement, charges, RP, concentration or spell activation. Fishing effects grant no attack, damage, save, AC candidate (including zero), resistance, proficiency, Strength, carrying relief or extra hand. Ordinary structural AC is an object-targeting profile. Physical damage compatibility and actual anatomy still apply.

At the catch check and secure capture, bind physical admission to that attempt, method, registered assembly and selected creature. Every indispensable body needs its own current state, including ordinary unenchanted members. Check the same creature's applicable mass and geometry profile against the admission and anatomy manifest. An omitted Broken Line, an unrelated smaller creature's admission, or conflicting current histories for the same piece cannot qualify a catch. Suppression alone does not break functional ordinary apparatus.

**Rod method:** one 6 ft Rod, one continuous 50 ft Line, one 2 in Hook, plus compatible ordinary bait, a finished Bait dose, or an artificial Lure. The 50 ft limit is the whole physical path including bends, depth and elevation. Two manipulating hands of the lead are required. One ordinary catch is limited to 10 lb, actual hook/body fit and the user's lower handling limit. Joined lines or rarity do not extend the admitted model. The optional Tackle winding board must actually mount to the rod or stable support and control that line. It is separate from the existing 1 gp/4 lb Fishing-tackle toolkit; no kit label creates unrecorded apparatus. A documented complete assembly can be the Fishing-tackle implement for catching without granting proficiency. Crafting/repair retain their own actual toolkit requirements.

**Net method:** one handled dip-net with 6 ft handle,2 ft hoop,2 ft-deep bag and 0.5 in mesh. It admits one catch up to 10 lb and 0.5 ft³ that fits and is retained by the mesh. Both lead hands, actual supported access and a target within the handle's 6 ft physical reach are required. Deployment/retrieval each take five active minutes. An unbaited Net can attempt visible/reachable eligible prey; preferential attraction requires actual compatible bait or an attached Lure. A second support net grants no second check or yield. This is no thrown combat Net, unattended gill net, automatic Restrained condition or escape-DC profile.

**Trap method:** an empty 24×12×12 in body has 22×10×10 in usable interior,4×4 in admission funnel,8×8 in service opening, one 10 lb/1 ft³ catch compartment, separate 0.10 lb bait holder and 20 ft recovery cord. Actual prey must enter and fit without ungranted compression. Setting needs five active minutes, both hands, real support/anchor and compatible ordinary bait or finished Bait. A stationary Lure can additionally contribute only with documented response compatibility; it never replaces required Trap bait. Freely circulating water is not cargo, but retained water on removal has real mass.

**Rig accessory:** the 6×4×4 in perforated steel dispenser has 5×3×3 in usable interior,1 pint and 1 lb chum limits, real support and 10 ft tether. Bind it to one assembly within 5 ft of its bait/capture point. It is no capture method or shared aura. Mounting the empty Rig takes five additional active minutes before main deployment; retrieving it takes five additional active minutes afterward. Load/open it during main deployment. One actual compatible pound of chum is consumed at first dispersal, reference 0.10 gp. One compatible finished 0.10 lb Bait dose can replace exactly 0.10 lb, leaving 0.90 lb ordinary chum required. That chum does not also fill another physical bait holder or hook. Residue has no reusable bait entitlement. No free starting/refill chum is supplied.

Record the actual dispenser, support, tether, presentation point, prior mounting work, load and first dispersal together. The load identifies available compatible ordinary chum portions and any finished Bait substitution; wrappers do not count toward chum mass. Each portion is spent once. A physically functional but suppressed Rig can be deployed without its magical benefit. Later suppression removes its benefit; breakage spills the spent allotment, and repair or restored magic does not refill it.

Closing the catch claim does not retrieve the Rig. Keep its actual location and equipment reservation until separate retrieval or express abandonment is recorded. Retrieval requires five additional active minutes by a capable worker using both hands, actual access and sufficient handling capacity, and an actual receiving location. The same worker cannot credit setup, fishing or catch-retrieval minutes again as Rig work. Handling records describe movement of the existing dispenser; they create no new inventory, chum, catch or opportunity.

Comparison arcane-focus Rods, combat Nets, ropes, Grappling hooks and Block and tackle retain their own profiles. No Fishing model gains focus, weapon, climbing, towing or human-support permission. Current Tackle outputs with historical boat names are control boards; their untouched legacy fields create no vehicle or additional recipe. The separately preserved transport backlog records those historical names.

## The one-shot unattended Trap

At completed setup, record the setter's actual WIS and applicable Fishing PB/expertise. The Trap alone permits a passive fifty-minute soak and one scheduled check at attempt minute 55. Only these configuration values are snapshotted: no future personal buff, aura or assistant bonus. Registered equipment/bait eligibility is current at resolution. No continuing consciousness, hands or concentration are required, and independent work may use passive-soak time if otherwise legal.

The check resolves once even if the setter is absent. Actual historical physical state, access, stock and suppression govern that due event. A successful entry and retention is secure capture inside the Trap, never inventory in the setter's backpack. No second catch accumulates. Actual capable retrieval needs five active minutes, both hands, legal cord/path and handling capacity. Life needs continue; the Trap supplies no air, clean water, food, obedience or preserved life.

An unresolved or unreconciled Trap occupies its responsible holder's deployment allowance, initially the setter's, until physically retrieved, lawfully handed over with the existing record, or expressly abandoned. Closing a failed, empty or finished catch claim leaves an unretrieved Trap in place and its holder's allowance occupied. A later actual retrieval or handover can reconcile that continuing obligation. Passive soaking does not itself qualify a beneficial rest or create a second deployment allowance.

Lawful accepted handover transfers responsibility to a person with a free allowance. Preserve the same attempt, spent opportunity, selected creature, original setter's configuration and canonical roll, active receipt and pending one-shot check. The original setter's WIS/proficiency cannot be replaced by the receiver's values or rewritten later. Current equipment still governs at resolution. Handover grants no new roll, automatic retrieval, refund or inventory.

Retrieval requires the capable retriever's five actual active minutes, both hands, admitted access along the legal recovery path, sufficient capacity for the real apparatus, contents and any transported catch, and actual receiving locations and elevations. The retriever need not be the setter. An escaped or released animal keeps its separate actual location; retrieving an empty Trap does not acquire that animal. Early actual retrieval cancels a pending check without producing a catch. Rig retrieval remains separate additional work. Releasing a reservation is not evidence that equipment returned to carried inventory.

Express abandonment cancels a pending check and closes future Fishing claims without refunding the spent opportunity or bait. Preserve the apparatus's actual location and any already captured animal's identity, life state, custody, location and recovery history. A reason string alone cannot stand in for those actual dispositions.

## Bait, ordinary bait and storage

One finished Bait is a single-use 0.10 lb magical carrier dose and a 0.01 lb ordinary wrapper:0.11 lb packaged,2×1×1 in, body reference 2 cp (one for each). The dose has HP 1; wrapper separately HP 1/AC11. Count components or inclusive package mass once. Unwrapping is not damage or exposure by itself. No part grants player food credit.

At first deliberate exposure, consume the whole usable dose entitlement and make one receipt attached to that attempt's assembly. The receipt lasts 60 elapsed minutes from exposure, or until the attempt closes. Ordinary swallowing/dispersal does not cancel it; this is the explicit consumable exception to continuing-body eligibility. It creates no creature condition or concentration. Scope-specific suppression must actually reach the assembly's bait effect. Different assemblies cannot inherit residue.

Bind that receipt to the actual dose identity, source recipe, inventory expenditure, assembly, exposure, expiry and current assembly-specific suppression. A registered but unexposed dose contributes nothing; a copied receipt without that attempt's actual debit cannot supply a bonus. Record the real bait or Lure presentation point and the actual physical source of each form. A Rod cannot supply the Lure form. Ordinary angling bait needs its own eligible portion and inventory/use record; a consumed recipe ingredient is not that portion. One physical ordinary portion cannot be spent again on another attempt. A dose substituted into Rig chum must be recorded in that dispenser's load rather than also placed on a hook or in a Trap holder.

Before exposure, a canceled still-eligible dose remains unused. After exposure, early retrieval, failure, escape, interruption, transfer or abandonment never refunds it. Retained residue has real mass but no fresh use. The same empty wrapper remains an ordinary object with no source-value recovery; reuse for a lawful new dose supplies no free dose. Rewrapping an unused dose preserves age. Destroyed/spoiled doses cannot expose.

A completed dry, properly wrapped dose reaches Spoiled directly after 24 accumulated unprotected hours from completion, losing its Fishing effect and ordinary finished-dose reference value. Opened but unexposed doses retain the same age. Only an actually compatible existing preservation method protects storage; no new stasis is granted. A receipt validly made before storage spoilage has its independent 60-minute life. No fractional dose works. Ordinary angling bait is a separate 0.10 lb/1 cp portion with its real prey compatibility and material spoilage. A consumed recipe ingredient marked bait is neither this portion nor a finished Bait dose.

Keep the dose's storage history from actual completion through exposure. Unwrapping, rewrapping and transfer preserve elapsed unprotected age; they do not supply a new completion timestamp. Protected intervals need their actual compatible existing preservation record. A later eligibility label cannot restore a destroyed or spoiled dose.

## Three independent equipment choices

Register physical candidates at deployment. Rod permits one each of Rod, Line, Hook, Tackle, Lure, bait receipt and Rig. Net permits its Net, qualifying attached Lure, bait receipt and Rig; Trap likewise its Trap, qualifying Lure, receipt and Rig. Actual fit can narrow these lists. Extra pieces remain ordinary support/cargo. One finished Bait receipt at most contributes, wherever legally placed.

Each durable item must independently be complete, positive-HP, unsuppressed, unmelded and participating in that method. A Rod strapped to a Trap or unused board on shore is ineligible. Every item view must describe the same canonical roll ID, kind, actor/configured setter, WIS ability, proficiency, task category, actual-roll and automatic-result status. Past check evidence cannot qualify the current event.

Supply a current view for every registered magical candidate, including ineligible ones. Omitting a stronger candidate is not proof that it stopped qualifying. Ordinary unenchanted members supply physical function without entering magical comparisons. Physical admission and the equipment modifier must use the same current history for an indispensable piece. For attended retrieval, the lead supplies both required hands and five actual work minutes; an assistant cannot substitute. Interrupted work can still finish before the registered closure checkpoint if all five minutes and physical requirements are met.

1. **Check bonus:** strongest eligible value once in `equipment.leather-task-enhancement`. Current catch checks are outside the existing Leatherworking/Tailoring/Jewelcrafting task predicates; shared family names grant no blanket Water-jewel or navigation bonus.
2. **Extra recovery:** strongest eligible printed extraYield once in `equipment.fishing-extra-recovery`. At secure capture it must have qualified for that check and still qualify. A now-ineligible strongest piece may leave a still-qualified weaker winner. Late equipment cannot enlarge the entitlement.
3. **Attraction:** select one eligible source/affinity before allocation, independently of either maximum. Different tags never automatically union.

For example, Hook 164(+1), Line 641(+2), Rod 179(+1) and Lure 160(+1) give+2 and at most two extra units, not+5 or five. Their selected attraction can come from any one independently eligible source. Two handlers do not duplicate the lead's effect. None of these catch modifiers automatically applies to harvesting, repair, research, combat or a separate handling check.

## Site stock and one response

The governing world supplies a finite site manifest: accessible region, stock shared across banks/map labels, real creature or finite stock-member IDs, opportunities, catch profiles/mass/geometry, receptive behavior, hazards, DCs, receiving access and documented renewal events. Unknown-to-player sites can have finite exploratory opportunities, including actual empty results. IDs and booleans alone are not proof of stock or fit.

Bind the opportunity to the applicable finite stock manifest and version, and to an allocation of its actual physical members. Candidate creatures must belong to that allocation. A whole-pool allocation includes every member of that version. Renaming a partition or shared-pool label cannot remove overlap with another route's actual resources. The bounded helper uses explicit finite membership to verify a disjoint allocation; it does not infer disjointness from labels. Stock versions, allocations and prey profiles must already apply at the response checkpoint, including any recorded effective interval.

At deployment commitment, spend the opportunity and allocate one response from actual candidates. Preferential attraction reaches at most 30 ft along an unobstructed connected water path from the real bait/Lure point, or the Rig dispenser. Apply real perception, movement, barriers, dry gaps and willingness/behavior; intelligent rejection or hostility is not compliance. No availability is created from ingredients, donor lists, creature names or Sustenance.

Exclude every candidate beyond that thirty-foot response region before weighting; a fish at thirty-one feet does not remain in the pool at weight 1. Record the actual presentation or dispenser point and bind each response path to that point and the opportunity's candidate set. The Rod's separate fifty-foot angler-to-hook deployment limit still applies. A separately governed ordinary visible response does not enlarge a selected-attraction allocation.

Sort actual eligible candidates by stable physical ID. Each affinity match has weight 2, each nonmatch weight 1. Draw one uniform integer over the sum, record list/version/draw, and reserve the selected creature atomically against competing deployments. This is no ability check; it gains no proficiency/advantage or extra yield. Multiple matching traits still weight 2. No matching affinity still allows ordinary receptive weight 1 candidates and independent catch/yield bonuses.

The reserved creature is not teleported, compelled, controlled, restrained or guaranteed to approach. If it becomes unavailable, never redraw a replacement for this opportunity. Later suppression does not reroll a completed allocation; no persistent attraction condition exists. Other anglers gain nothing from that choice. Known empty/impossible opportunities checked before commitment cost no nonexistent opportunity or bait. A real exploratory opportunity that resolves empty afterward spends its opportunity and exposed bait, records actual work, and may stop unused future work without refund.

No hourly, dawn, Watch, rest, scene, transfer or renaming refill exists. Fresh opportunities need a documented real change, such as previously unattempted accessible stock, a governed arrival or materially new approach, with cause/time. A failed attempt spends its opportunity without automatically resetting the specimen. Waiting or new IDs cannot renew anatomy or recovery history.

For renewed or recapture opportunities, link that actual cause and time to the prior attempt, same creature and current stock version. After a previous capture, record the intervening release or escape, prior capture identity and actual receiving location. Carry the preceding material history into the new attempt and retain the first recovery evaluation, including zero. A new name for an empty exploratory allocation also needs a real new cause; it grants no replacement draw or stock by itself.

## Affinity registry

An independently approved explicit affinity is sufficient. Otherwise use only actual intrinsic profile evidence below. Ingredients, temporary borrowed bonuses, moral alignment or cosmetic names are insufficient. These NEW mappings specify game predicates without deciding cosmic origin.

| Affinity | Intrinsic evidence (or explicit independently approved affinity) |
|---|---|
| Acid | A printed innate attack, secretion or power that produces acid/corrosion. |
| Fire | A printed innate attack, physiology or power that produces fire/heat. |
| Lightning | A printed innate attack, physiology or power that produces electricity/lightning; thunder alone is insufficient. |
| Poison | A printed innate venom/toxin production or poison-delivery ability. |
| Water | An expressly aquatic body/habitat profile, intrinsic swimming movement mode or intrinsic underwater-breathing trait; ordinary ability to attempt swimming is insufficient. |
| Earth | A printed earth/stone body trait or intrinsic movement through soil/stone. |
| Flora | Actual Plant creature type or explicitly botanical/fungal anatomy. |
| Arcane | Intrinsic expressly magical creature nature, innate spellcasting or an explicitly magical native power, regardless of casting tradition. |
| Psychic | An intrinsic expressly psychic attack or native thought-reading, memory, mental-command or telepathic ability. Mere intelligence/sentience is insufficient. |
| Unholy | Actual Undead type, an intrinsic necrotic power or an innate effect expressly operating as a curse. Fiend, “evil,” a spirit-name or an ingredient label alone is insufficient. |
| Stealth | Explicit intrinsic Stealth proficiency or a native concealment/hiding feature. A temporary decision to hide is insufficient. |
| Strength | An actual intrinsic Strength score of at least **16**, before temporary borrowed modifiers. This threshold is a NEW mechanical mapping, not an inferred species statistic. |
| Vitality | An explicit native regeneration or bodily self-recovery trait. Merely being alive, having high HP or receiving outside healing is insufficient. |

Resistance/immunity alone does not establish elemental or Poison affinity. Poison affinity is not poison damage, so matching immunity does not cancel attraction. A Fire-tagged Net has no heat or environmental immunity. Secondary recipe tags are preserved metadata, not extra attraction modes. No elemental tag provides a new aquatic adaptation, donor organ or stat block.

## Secure capture and the one body record

Rod/Net success at minute 55 is interception. Five real retrieval work minutes must reach secure control in an actual receiving hand, net, container or supported landing place. There is no second routine landing roll; a real independently governed obstacle may require its own check. Interruption must still permit those five minutes before closure ten elapsed minutes after the check. Actual expiry/closure order governs identical displayed timestamps.

Before secure capture, broken line/support or escape yields neither catch inventory nor extra recovery. Record real location and remaining apparatus. Legitimate recovery while the attempt stays open is the same attempt, without a new catch roll. After deadline, rescue/encounter procedures can continue independently but cannot extend its magical entitlement. Trap secure entry already passed capture; later retrieval is cargo handling.

Capture is not death, butchery, taming, command or allegiance. Preserve the same real creature's life state, conditions, custody, origin, physical body and finite anatomy. No meat appears while still attached to a living body. Killing, nonlethal handling or other extraction must be independently legal. Carrying shortage does not delete it: actual release, transfer or placement preserves location/elevation. A hook never melds a living catch with gear.

At the first secure capture under this system, evaluate extra recovery exactly once, **including zero from ordinary gear**. Release, recapture, ownership, preservation, sale or renaming cannot raise it or repeat it. A new justified recapture opportunity moves the same identity and history. A later lawful harvester may use the already recorded allocation without the old Fishing item. Summoned, transformed, bonded and exceptional bodies retain their own no-resource restrictions.

Keep immutable source-origin restrictions separately from current access permission. A later permitted-access record cannot erase a no-resource origin or authorize either baseline or reserve extraction from that prohibited body. Preserve the actual pre-attempt and captured material records so later edits cannot replace the history that governed the first evaluation.

## Real material recovery

Before the attempt, the governing catch profile records disjoint baseline units, extra-recovery reserve units, damaged potentially recoverable baseline units and unique/exceptional drops within one physical anatomy/mass ceiling. Roll ordinary base yield once when constructing that manifest. The reserve is real ordinary material otherwise lost in capture/processing, never anatomy invented to fulfill+3.

Before the catch check, choose an order of actually known permitted recovery categories; hidden units retain a neutral preregistered order without disclosing lore or value. At secure capture, let E be the strongest still-eligible extraYield among sources that qualified for that check. Authorize the first min(E,available reserve count) real reserve units in that predeclared order. This is entitlement to later extraction, not loose inventory. Missing reserve gives zero actual units with source E unchanged; nothing banks. Later loss, damage, contamination or decay can reduce it, never be undone by the earlier manifest.

Each later material record names its actual predecessor and the governing transitions for changed units. Preserve donor and unit identity, category, nonincreasing recoverable mass, and records of lost, destroyed, removed, spent or forfeited units. A new snapshot cannot restore those units. Any separately lawful change in condition needs its actual governing procedure and transition; it does not reopen the Fishing evaluation or replenish mass.

Generic known edible ordinary fish meat has a NEW1 lb accounting unit, TierI, no elemental property, value unknown. Baseline fractions remain actual mass to 0.01 lb; an extra meat unit needs a whole additional physical pound. Named source material units retain their own masses/indivisibility and ingredient qualification. A0.40 lb flesh supply remains at most 0.40 lb with+3; a 1 lb baseline plus three real 1 lb reserve portions can permit 4 lb only after legal successful extraction.

The whole-pound requirement governs a new meat-reserve entitlement. If an already authorized one-pound portion later suffers real loss leaving 0.75 pound, at most that 0.75 pound remains extractable. It is the same diminished unit; neither the missing quarter pound nor another entitlement appears, and unrelated valid portions keep their own histories.

Identification, source/tierDC, time, tools, one extraction assistant, partial-harvest forfeiture and preservation follow the shared harvesting guide. Fishing may be an appropriate aquatic extraction trade, but these item catch bonuses do not modify extraction. Harvest Critical Success can recover its separate prerecorded damaged baseline unit, never the same reserve unit or a new unique drop. Partial harvest fixes categories and forfeits unselected allocations, including their reserve. Failure or later workers cannot reopen them.

Each extracted lot keeps donor/unit IDs, exact component identity where established, tier, role/form, mass, quantity, condition, value or unknown value, and actual death/removal time. Usable does not imply edible, detoxified, unrestricted or an exact named catalog ingredient. Actual tissue hazards and exceptional-drop conditions remain. Preserve material age through capture, transfer and repackaging; ordinary meat uses the existing eight-hour interval unless a specific source differs.

The capture and recovery authorization must already exist when extraction occurs. Actual death/removal times cannot lie in the extraction's future. Bind them to the real donor and affected units through the governing lifecycle record. Preserve established timestamps; a separately documented correction must retain the prior timestamp and its evidence. Sale, repackaging or a different harvester does not reset age.

## Chronology, physical state and transformations

Use one authoritative campaign ledger with `(time, phase, sequence)` and expected current version. Reject earlier, replayed and conflicting transitions. Process due Trap checks, bait expiry and closure in their historical order before later events; current repaired state cannot replace missed historical state. Record allocations, opportunities, exposure, capture and terminal outcomes once. Copied dice, replacement results, report reloads or callbacks create no second debit or catch.

Suppression removes currently applicable magic while ordinary body/custody remains. It neither reopens resolved dice nor automatically releases physically held prey. Secure-capture entitlement uses then-current eligible sources; once validly attached it is not undone/refilled by later suppression. HP 0 removes indispensable capture function. Broken Trap/retaining Net releases through actual placement unless independently recorded intact support really holds the animal; a broken integral cord/wall is no independent restraint. Broken Rig spills remaining spent chum at its location, with no free bait or animal damage.

Voluntary form change reconciles deployment before paying. Remote anchored gear does not meld through ownership. Actual detached/dropped/carried gear follows the body guide; mandatory changes use existing overflow placement. Melded equipment supplies no hands, deployment function, bonuses or accessible bait. An independently deployed Trap can finish its one-shot schedule; an actually melded attended assembly cannot. Count full mass/Load for meld preflight and rescuers. Return keeps existing external equipment priority and actual carried/drop/pending placement/elevation; it creates no catch, opportunity, receipt or age reset.

## Craft the source recipe

Use WIS, the actual non-artisan Fishing-tackle credential and Fishing toolkit, Knife, Bait container and suitable shoreline/dock/fishing station. Ordinary tools/facility grant+0. Do not add trade level. Existing untrained level 1–4 disadvantage, higher-level formula access and actual recipe gates apply. Fishing pieces do not improve their own creation, research or repair. **Forge Dwarf's artisan time and quality benefits do not apply.** Creation assistants work all actual order hours, obey the recipe cap and never shorten the work.

The original 1 gp/4 lb toolkit and 1 gp/0.25 lb Small knife can meet their actual requirements; the knife gains no dagger profile. A NEW reusable lidded wooden Bait container is 0.10 gp/0.25 lb empty,HP 5/AC15,5×3×3 in interior,maximum 1 pint and 1 lb contents. Both weight and real shape apply; at most nine 0.11 lb packets fit by weight, possibly fewer by packing. It supplies no bait, stasis or magical containment. Actual compatible existing containers may substitute without double purchase/counting. A bucket does not acquire a lid or preservation. This implement is not a tenth output family.

Honor every exact fieldCraftable flag and timeMode. True field flags still need their suitable field/fortified-camp station conditions; false flags still need workshop/Haven/legacy access. Being on a shore is no workshop, and a room supplies no water or fish. Creation restrictions do not prohibit lawful later field use. Preserve source hours, assistant cap, discovery, minimum level and trivialAtSkillLevel exactly; never regenerate level+5.

Reserve floor(1.5 Q) complete actual mundane bodies, or that many real 0.10 lb carrier blanks and 0.01 lb wrappers for Bait, before work. Give each a stable order and exclusive reservation. Durable bodies are complete, functional, Standard grade and never previously magically altered; record current/maximumHP, existing structural improvement/flaw, source value and required original constituents. Empty Trap/Rig stock includes only integral fittings. Positive-HP damage is legal. Missing/Broken/incomplete/unavailable reserves pause completion before the roll; lawful repair/replacement keeps its position. Use latest lawful state, not an old snapshot or an asserted flag.

Bind each reserve to its actual body model, creation record, current inventory and exclusive order reservation. The family and fixed profile must match the recipe; a Hook is not a Trap body. Two outputs cannot share one physical constituent. Bait requires eligible carriers and wrappers with separate identities, or a governed exclusive packaged-stock identity that accounts for both materials and masses. Destroyed or spoiled carriers or wrappers never qualify through an old eligibility label. Keep the actual resolved batch outcome and preregistered reserve order together.

All 212 component occurrences in this trade are consumed process inputs, separately mandatory once per batch. No catalyst exists, so catalyst return is zero. Their names, role bait, source donor lists and optional guidance never substitute for bodies, tools, ordinary bait or reusable material. Failed recovery follows the framework's exact 25% non-catalyst quantity and indivisibility rules with original ages; Mishap/abandonment recover none. Unretained process mass is waste with no new saleable entitlement.

The first 15 active minutes form an included stable incorporation phase. Only actually incorporated eligible inputs stabilize in that workpiece. Untouched/recovered/replacement/perishable lots retain their clocks and real containment; no phase saves already spoiled stock. Divide remaining work into preregistered phases of at most 8 hours. Forced interruption loses unfinished phase progress, preserving real consumed/destroyed inputs; newly ineligible reserves pause before rolling. Replacements give no old-input or phase refund. Finished Bait age starts at its actual completion. Work, rest, station access and elapsed preservation clocks never reset each other.

## Quality, conservation and repair

Standard givesQ; Exceptional yield floor(1.25 Q); Masterwork yield floor(1.5 Q). Transform the first resolvedN bodies, with no post-roll replacement/reordering/purchase. Alternatively, durable Exceptional/Masterwork transforms firstQ with strongest 25%/50% structural improvement. LetB=ordinaryHP andP=strongest percentage: maximum=B ifP0, otherwise B+max(1,floor(B×P/100)); then one persistent flaw halves once, floor,minimum 1. Preserve damage deficit: newcurrent=clamp(newmax−(oldmax−oldcurrent),0,newmax). Improvements/flaws never compound or heal. DurableB5 gives 5/6/7, or 2/3/3 with flaw. A1/5 singleton becoming Flawed can finish 0/2 Broken.

Validate the old maximum against the recorded ordinary HP, strongest improvement and persistent flaw before applying that formula. An unmodified B5 body recorded at 1/1 is contradictory; do not normalize it into a healed 5/5 item. Current damage, improvement and flaw must agree with the governing body history.

ForQ≥2, Flawed makes floor(Q/2) ordinary-effect bodies/doses, retaining old durable flaws without adding a new singleton flaw merely because yield becomes 1. A durableQ1 Flawed adds one persistent flaw. **BaitQ1 Flawed instead resolves as Failed** with normal failed non-catalyst recovery and zero magical doses. Bait Exceptional/Masterwork may increase whole-dose yield or retainQ with quality label only. No durability, extra use, longer storage/receipt, bonus, capacity, affinity or charge improvement exists. Failed/Mishap transforms none; unused reserves remain their actual ordinary stock, not ingredient recovery.

Repair needs trained WIS+one Fishing PB, actual toolkit/Knife/Bait container and suitable station. FunctionalHP≥1: DC 10, max(1 hour,recordedmaxHP/10 hours), material reference 25% undamaged mundane body value. BrokenHP0: actual recipe craftingDC,max(8 hours,recordedmaxHP/10 hours),material reference 25% undamaged finished-unit value. Core tool outcomes collapse to success/failure; success restores recorded maximum, failure spends work/materials. No creation-level/formula gate,quality,XP,catalyst,Forge Dwarf reduction or flaw removal applies.

Repair requires the original primary assembly listed on the card and every additionally recorded irreplaceable constituent. Minor fittings/patches may be replaced; missing primary members or original Line span cannot be invented. Recovered original severed Line sections can be spliced, but shared fragments cannot rebuild two items. Do not retrospectively require every consumed process ingredient to remain intact. Preserve physical identity, grade, improvement, flaw, spent bait/chum, opportunity/catch/recovery histories and fit. Bait cannot be repaired/reconstructed. A separately available reviewed service is an alternative actual quote, not an extra automatic fee or missing-body exception.

Obtain that required assembly from the item's original creation/body record and its actual surviving inventory. A newly supplied list containing a clip cannot replace a Rod's shaft requirement. Use the admitted model's mundane price and the finished item's actual recipe for repair references; Hook pricing cannot stand in for Rod pricing. Arithmetic alone is a quotation, not evidence that a body qualifies for repair, and qualification itself does not complete the work or restore HP.

## Value, food and the Supply boundary

Finished undamaged unit reference = source recommended Standard batch value/Q + actual mundane body reference; Bait adds 0.02 gp. Never divide by final quality yield or add ingredient/tool costs twice. Owned reserves need no repurchase. Keep actual acquisitions,station costs,bait/chum and commissions separate; use actual quote and source 50% deposit without duplicate supplied-input charges. Purchases ceil and sales floor to copper once. No automatic buyer,profit,grade/rarity/artifact multiplier,melt value or damaged/flawed/depleted sale price follows.

An exposed Bait has zero saleable magical uses. An unused sold dose keeps age/condition/use. Material unknown value stays unknown. Generic fish meat is not automatically recipe 642's exact Shark meat component or priced at the ration reference. Only genuinely matching safe tier/form/role/quantity can fulfill a recipe or authorized substitution. Valid Cooking uses actual eligible meat mass once; a completed serving remains 2/3 lb and supplies 1/3 Small/Medium daily food or 1/6 Large. A raw catch is not a serving. Fishing manufacture grants no Cooking neutralization or whole-creature trait.

Fishing produces actual creatures/material lots, **no complete Supply Unit**,water,fuel or camp goods. It does not certify or enhance the existing unfinished abstract Forage procedure. Choose one production route per actual resource pool per Watch; the first committed route excludes overlapping Fishing/Forage claims unless authoritative allocation proves disjoint physical stock. Renaming or conversion cannot keep both representations. Sustenance 0 blocks ordinary Forage but does not disprove separately documented fish; positive Sustenance creates no fish manifest or price. Later Supply conversion needs its own agreed rule.

## Evidence and scope

All eleven required exact-review corrections (FI-E01–11) are fulfilled. The version-bound completion receipt records the repaired rules, original valid sequence coverage, finite regressions, exact effect paragraphs, complete audience projections and protected sources. The actual verdict authorizes this operational PLAYTEST promotion. Original submissions and historical hashes remain preserved separately.

Each card preserves original source fields and distinguishes its operational additions. Source developed/needsReview flags confer no card approval. Public records retain all six source-book paragraphs where bound; private records/guidance stay in their separate audience. Historical boat names and literal source links remain history, not availability or transport grants. Whole-creature-use flags supply no unprinted effect.

The bounded reference helper must require real governing-world records and chronological evidence. Its calculations cannot prove actual stock,fit,local behavior,legal placement or authority from caller booleans. The completed repair gate compared all cards, guides, JSON, worked cases and complete audience projections against the actual exact verdict. Full vehicle,Forage,Supply,bestiary,market,companion runtime and human balance remain their own work. Cosmology stays after the authorized GitHub push and verified remote commit.

Bind them to the real donor and affected units through the governing lifecycle record. Preserve established timestamps; a separately documented correction must retain the prior timestamp and its evidence. Sale, repackaging or a different harvester does not reset age.

## Value, food and the Supply boundary

Finished undamaged unit reference = source recommended Standard batch value/Q + actual mundane body reference; Bait adds 0.02 gp. Never divide by final quality yield or add ingredient/tool costs twice. Owned reserves need no repurchase. Keep actual acquisitions,station costs,bait/chum and commissions separate; use actual quote and source 50% deposit without duplicate supplied-input charges. Purchases ceil and sales floor to copper once. No automatic buyer,profit,grade/rarity/artifact multiplier,melt value or damaged/flawed/depleted sale price follows.

An exposed Bait has zero saleable magical uses. An unused sold dose keeps age/condition/use. Material unknown value stays unknown. Generic fish meat is not automatically recipe 642's exact Shark meat component or priced at the ration reference. Only genuinely matching safe tier/form/role/quantity can fulfill a recipe or authorized substitution. Valid Cooking uses actual eligible meat mass once; a completed serving remains 2/3 lb and supplies 1/3 Small/Medium daily food or 1/6 Large. A raw catch is not a serving. Fishing manufacture grants no Cooking neutralization or whole-creature trait.

Fishing produces actual creatures/material lots, **no complete Supply Unit**,water,fuel or camp goods. It does not certify or enhance the existing unfinished abstract Forage procedure. Choose one production route per actual resource pool per Watch; the first committed route excludes overlapping Fishing/Forage claims unless authoritative allocation proves disjoint physical stock. Renaming or conversion cannot keep both representations. Sustenance 0 blocks ordinary Forage but does not disprove separately documented fish; positive Sustenance creates no fish manifest or price. Later Supply conversion needs its own agreed rule.
